entry.title: aws/aws-sdk-net - Releases - 2025-08-12
entry.content:
4.0.68.0

4.0.68.0 (2025-08-12 19:48 UTC)

  • BackupSearch (4.0.2.0)
    • Using recommended smithy trait to generate regional endpoints for Backup Search
  • CodeBuild (4.0.3.0)
    • AWS CodeBuild now supports PullRequestBuildPolicy in webhook object.
  • EC2 (4.0.29.0)
    • Release to allow route table association with a PublicIpv4Pool.
  • Organizations (4.0.2.0)
    • This release introduces 2 new APIs in Organizations: 1. ListAccountsWithInvalidEffectivePolicy 2. ListEffectivePolicyValidationErrors
  • SageMaker (4.0.18.0)
    • IAM Identity Center trusted identity propagation is now supported in SageMaker Studio.
  • TranscribeService (4.0.3.0)
    • AWS HealthScribe now supports specifying preferred patient pronouns through the MedicalScribeContext parameter for use in the generated clinical notes.
  • TranscribeStreaming (4.0.2.0)
    • AWS HealthScribe now supports specifying preferred patient pronouns through the MedicalScribeContext parameter for use in the generated clinical notes.

3.7.1100.0

3.7.1100.0 (2025-08-12 18:21 UTC)

  • BackupSearch (3.7.502.0)
    • Using recommended smithy trait to generate regional endpoints for Backup Search
  • CodeBuild (3.7.502.0)
    • AWS CodeBuild now supports PullRequestBuildPolicy in webhook object.
  • EC2 (3.7.503.0)
    • Release to allow route table association with a PublicIpv4Pool.
  • Organizations (3.7.501.0)
    • This release introduces 2 new APIs in Organizations: 1. ListAccountsWithInvalidEffectivePolicy 2. ListEffectivePolicyValidationErrors
  • SageMaker (3.7.504.0)
    • IAM Identity Center trusted identity propagation is now supported in SageMaker Studio.
  • TranscribeService (3.7.501.0)
    • AWS HealthScribe now supports specifying preferred patient pronouns through the MedicalScribeContext parameter for use in the generated clinical notes.
  • Core 3.7.500.7
    • Updating endpoints.json file.
    • All services packages updated to require new Core

entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2025-08-12
entry.content:
Azure.Monitor.Query_1.7.1

1.7.1 (2025-08-12)

Other Changes

  • Updated internal serialization paths to use an AOT-friendly approach. The package now fully supports AOT and is trimmable.

Azure.Core_1.47.2

1.47.2 (2025-08-11)

Features Added

  • Adopt System.ClientModel 1.6.0

Azure.ResourceManager.Compute_1.11.0

1.11.0 (2025-08-12)

Features Added

  • Make Azure.ResourceManager.Compute AOT-compatible
  • Upgraded api-version tag from 'package-2025-02-01' to 'package-2025-03-01'. Tag detail available at https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/0f03ae6d4107a964b20a48aa87fa520052750bb9/specification/compute/resource-manager/readme.md.
    • Added new classes: SupportedSecurityOption, AvailabilityPolicyDiskDelay, SnapshotAccessState, AvailabilityPolicy.
    • Added SecurityMetadataUri and InstantAccessDurationMinutes properties to DiskCreationData class.
    • Added SecurityMetadataAccessSas property to AccessUri class.
    • Added AvailabilityPolicy property to ManagedDiskData and ManagedDiskUpdateData classes.
    • Added SupportedSecurityOption property to SupportedCapabilities class.
    • Added SnapshotAccessState to SnapshotData and SnapshotUpdateData classes.

Breaking Changes

  • Removed GetVirtualMachineImagesWithPropertiesExpand class as it has no utility.

Azure.ResourceManager.ContainerServiceFleet_1.2.0-beta.1

1.2.0-beta.1 (2025-08-12)

Features Added

  • Upgraded api-version tag to 'package-2025-04-01-preview'. Tag detail available at https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/d19d4d8c69cf37c355ee55095b335ca92643120e/specification/containerservice/resource-manager/Microsoft.ContainerService/fleet/readme.md.
    • Added Gates support.
    • Added FleetMember labels support.
    • Added TargetKubernetesVersion support.
  • Make Azure.ResourceManager.ContainerServiceFleet AOT-compatible.

Azure.ResourceManager.DataMigration_1.0.0-beta.6

1.0.0-beta.6 (2025-08-04)

Features Added

  • Upgraded the API version to 2025-03-15-preview.
  • Added support for Azure Blob to SQL MI migrations using Managed Identities.

Azure.ResourceManager.MySql_1.1.2

1.1.2 (2025-08-11)

Features Added

  • Make Azure.ResourceManager.MySql AOT-compatible

Azure.ResourceManager.ContainerRegistry_1.3.1

1.3.1 (2025-08-11)

Features Added

  • Make Azure.ResourceManager.ContainerRegistry AOT-compatible

Azure.ResourceManager.MachineLearning_1.2.3

1.2.3 (2025-08-11)

Features Added

  • Make Azure.ResourceManager.MachineLearning AOT-compatible

Azure.ResourceManager.DesktopVirtualization_1.3.2

1.3.2 (2025-08-11)

Features Added

  • Make Azure.ResourceManager.DesktopVirtualization AOT-compatible

Azure.Search.Documents_11.7.0-beta.6

11.7.0-beta.6 (2025-08-11)

Features Added

  • Enable the new model serialization using System.ClientModel, refer to this document for more details.
  • Added new AOT-compatible overloads for Search<T> and SearchAsync<T> that take JsonTypeInfo<T>.
